records.source: Reuters / Stephanie Kelly, Helen Clark, Trixie Yap / oil and Hormuz risk
records.claim: Reuters Nov16 reports Brent $95.32 and WTI $88.29 at 11:14 GMT; IEA forecast Q4 supply 105 mb/d, 1.7 mb/d above demand. October Chinese refinery throughput fell 2% m/m and 8.1% y/y. Iran IRGC mine/tanker allegations could not be independently verified.
records.observation: Spot price and forecast do not establish a confirmed new passage capacity; mine claims explicitly unverified. October refinery data are historical measurements published Nov16.
records.assessment: MARKET SIGNAL AND PROJECTION DISTINCT FROM VERIFIED FLOW

records.source: PortNews / US CBP Jones Act waiver conditions effective Nov16
records.claim: PortNews cites US Customs and Border Protection notice: third 90-day Jones Act extension effective 16 November; foreign-flag cargo must be eligible and voyages reviewed individually. Eligible cargo load deadline 14 February 2027.
records.observation: Policy becomes effective Nov16; not proof of approval of a particular shipment or retail price decline.
records.assessment: NEW POLICY EFFECTIVENESS NOT NEW COMMISSIONED SHIPPING

records.source: Reuters / IEA oil report and emergency releases
records.claim: IEA report dated Nov13 projects quarterly oil surplus, identifies persistent diesel shortage and scheduled emergency releases; Reuters Nov16 specifies 71 million barrels pledged by end February, including 15 million diesel.
records.observation: IEA projected and planned stocks distinct from actually released or delivered reserve fuel.
